✨Learn how to make the BEST soft & gooey cinnamon rolls made tik-tok style with heavy cream. These cinnamon rolls with cream cheese frosting are a fan faovrite and will become your go-to cinnamon rolls! FULL RECIPE AT GIMMEDELICIOUS.COM (link in bio!) Ingredients For the dough: ¾ cup warm milk 2 ¼ teaspoons quick rise or active yeast 1/4-ounce package yeast ¼ cup granulated sugar ¼ cup butter melted 1 egg 2 ¾ cups all-purpose flour plus more if needed 1/2 teaspoon salt For the filling: 1 cup brown sugar light or dark 2 tablespoons ground cinnamon ½ cup butter softened or almost melted 1 cup heavy cream DO NOT MIX INTO FILLING For the cream cheese frosting: 4 oz cream cheese softened 4 tablespoons butter softened 1 cup powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Instructions To Make Dough: Warm milk in the microwave for 30 seconds, to just about 110F. Transfer warm milk to a large bowl or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook. Sprinkle yeast on top. Stir milk and yeast until yeast is mostly dissolved. Add Sugar, butter, egg, flour, and salt. Knead dough on medium speed for 3-4 minutes. The dough might seem wet at first but will become less sticky as you knead it. The dough should be soft, elastic, tacky and smooth. If the dough is still too wet, add another 1-2 tablespoons of flour. Alternatively, this can be done by hand. Grease prepared dough with oil and cover with plastic wrap or kitchen towel. Allow to rise for about 30 minutes or until almost doubled in size. To Make Filling: While the dough is rising, prepare the filling. In a medium bowl, combine the softened butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon (DO NOT add heavy cream). Mix until well combined; set aside. Once the dough has doubled in size, transfer it to a well-floured surface and Roll it into a 9x14-inch rectangle using a rolling pin. Spread filling over dough, leaving about 1/4 inch border all around the outside of the dough. Starting with the 14’’ side, tightly roll into a log and place the seam down to ensure it’s sealed. Cut the dough into 4 equal segments then cut each segment into 3 rolls, about 1 inch each. You should end up with about 12 equal slices. Place the rolls in a buttered or greased 9×13 dish. Cover with a towel to rise for 1 hour. Preheat the oven to 350F. Heat heavy cream in the microwave for 30 seconds until lukewarm. Pour heavy cream evenly over rolls and bake for 25-30 minutes or until the tops are a light golden brown. To make the frosting: While the rolls are cooling, in the bowl of an electric mixer or by hand, combine the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract. Beat until smooth and fluffy. Spread onto the warm rolls and enjoy! #gimmedelicious #cinnamonrolls #baking #cinnabun #recipes

Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. S’mores banana bread 🪵✨ Ingredients - 113g unsalted butter, browned (1/2 cup) - 3 ripe bananas, mashed - 2 large eggs - 105g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) - 118g dark or light  brown sugar (1/2 cup) - 240g all-purpose flour (2 cups) - 60g crushed graham cracker crumbs (1/2 cup) -  130g sour cream (1/2 cup) - 1 tbsp heavy cream - 125g chocolate chips (3/4 cup) - 45g mini marshmallows (about one cup) - 2 tsp vanilla extract  - 1 tsp baking soda - 1/4 tsp salt Topping - Mini marshmallows - Crushed graham crackers - Hershey's chocolate bars Instructions - Preheat oven to 425F (220°C) Line or grease a 1.5 pound loaf pan. - Brown the butter over medium heat until golden and nutty. Remove from the heat, stir in the heavy cream, and let cool for 10–15 minutes. - In a large bowl whisk together the browned butter, mashed granulated sugar,  brown sugar, and  eggs until smooth. Add vanilla, sour cream and mix until combined. - In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. - Fold the flour and crushed graham crackers into the wet ingredients until just combined. Gently fold in the chocolate chips and mini marshmallows. - Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 10 minutes - Without opening the oven, reduce temperature to 350°F (175°C) Continue baking for 45–55 minutes, tenting with foil if needed. Bake until a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs. - Remove the loaf from the oven and immediately top with mini marshmallows and crushed graham crackers. Return to the oven for 3–5 minutes, or broil for 30–60 seconds, until the marshmallows are lightly toasted. - While the loaf is still hot, top with pieces of Hershey's chocolate and let them soften from the residual heat. - Cool in the pan for 15–20 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack before slicing. • • • #baking #recipes #bakingrecipe #bananabread

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

videos.caption: STOP BUYING store-bought cookies… make these instead.✨ The best part? If you break down the exact amount of ingredients used, these cookies cost less than $10 to make. Here’s your next pot luck dish or hostess gift👍 I love making these dairy free so they can easily be served after a meat meal, but you can absolutely use regular butter and dairy fillings if you prefer. Ingredients: • 3½ cups all purpose flour (500 g) • ¾ tablespoon baking powder (10 g) • ½ cup powdered sugar (75 g), plus more for dusting • 3 sticks non-dairy butter (340 g)  • ⅓ cup oil (80 mL) • Pinch of salt • Slightly less than ¼ cup water (about 50–55 mL) Water can be substituted with orange juice or milk if making dairy cookies. Fillings: • Plant-based Nutella • Crushed hazelnuts • Date spread • Crumbled halva • Biscoff cookie butter • Crushed Biscoff cookies Instructions: Place all dough ingredients into a mixer or large bowl and combine until a soft, pliable dough forms. If the dough feels too dry, add a little more liquid, 1 tablespoon at a time. If it feels too wet, add a little more flour. The dough is very forgiving. Divide dough into 3 equal pieces. Place dough between 2 sheets of parchment paper and roll into a thin rectangle or oval, about ⅛ inch thick. Spread your filling of choice and add toppings. Using the parchment paper to help guide you, carefully roll the dough into a log, gently peeling back the parchment as you go. Using a knife or bench scraper, cut cookies about ¾ inch thick and transfer onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. I like using a bench scraper to help lift the cookies. Repeat with remaining dough. Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for about 25–30 minutes. Once completely cooled, dust generously with powdered sugar and enjoy. These freeze beautifully. Store in a cookie jar on the counter, in the refrigerator for extra freshness, or freeze the dough ahead of time until needed. #sivanskitchen #easy #baking #cookies #savemoney

The easiest most foolproof artisan bread✨ . I discovered this method from @merryboosters years ago and it has been my go-to ever since 🙏🏼❤️ . ▪️390g (or ~3 Cups) Artisan Bread Flour or All Purpose Flour▪️2 tsp Sugar▪️1+1/2 tsp Salt▪️3/4 tsp Instant or Active Dried Yeast▪️300ml (1+1/4 Cups) Water▪️Butter, for serving▪️ . 1️⃣ In a large bowl mix together the flour, salt, sugar and yeast 2️⃣ Add some lukewarm water (~110°F) and mix everything together to form a shaggy mass of dough 3️⃣ Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let sit and rise in a warm environment for about 2 hours 4️⃣ After 2 hours, preheat the oven to 450°F with a Dutch oven inside (so the Dutch oven gets preheated as well) 5️⃣ Transfer the dough on to a floured work surface (the dough will be sticky so dust it with some flour whenever needed); knead the dough (fold it on to itself, turn, and repeat) for 2-3 mins until a tensive dough ball forms 6️⃣ Transfer to a proofing basket or parchment lined bowl, cover and let rise for 35 mins or until the dough doubles in size 7️⃣ Place the dough ball in the preheated Dutch oven lined with parchment and bake at 450°F for 30 minutes; reduce the oven temperature to 400°F, remove the lid, and bake for another 10-15 more minutes (at this point the longer you bake the bread the crispier the crust will be.. just make sure the bottom doesn't burn) - enjoy with salted butter! . Note: If you are making bread on a regular baking tray instead of a Dutch oven, steam is the key factor for making crusty bread. Place a pan with hot water in the lowest rack of oven while baking and spraying with water inside the oven during the initial five minutes of baking to help create this steamy environment inside the oven.  . ⏲ 10 minute prep time + 2 hour 35 minute rise time + 40 minute cook time . #homemadebread #bread #artisanbreadathome #easyrecipes #cookingtiktok #freshbread

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Raspberry cheesecake donuts ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Raspberry jam - 300g raspberries (about 2 cups) - 225g granulated sugar (1 cup + 2 tbsp) - Juice of 1/2 lemon - Cornstarch slurry Cheesecake filling - 5 oz cream cheese, softened  - 250g powdered sugar (2 cups) - 57g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 45g heavy cream (3 tbsp) - 2 tsp vanilla extract - 1 dolop of raspberry jam - 1/4 tsp salt  Raspberry sugar  - 15g freeze dried raspberries, blended (about 1 cup) - 120g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) Instructions  - In a large bowl, bloom the yeast with 1 tbsp honey in the warm milk for 5–10 minutes, or until foamy - Add eggs, sugar, vanilla extract and mix until well combined. - Add the flour and salt, then mix until a shaggy consistency  - Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface (or use a stand mixer) and knead for 10–20 minutes, adding 1 tbsp of softened butter at a time until fully incorporated. Continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - While the dough rises, make the raspberry jam by cooking the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice until thick. Add a cornstarch slurry if needed. Let cool. - Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, heavy cream, vanilla, salt, and a dollop of raspberry jam until fluffy. Refrigerate both fillings while the dough rises, then let them sit at room temperature before filling. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place the dough balls on a parchment-lined baking tray, leaving space between each. - Cover loosely and let rise for 30–40 minutes, or until puffy. When gently poked, the dough should slowly spring back, leaving a slight indentation. - In a large skillet heat oil to 315–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry the donuts, flipping every 30–45 seconds, until evenly golden brown and cooked through (about 2–3 minutes total). - Transfer the donuts to a wire rack to drain for 1–2 minutes. - Mix the freeze-dried raspberry powder with the sugar, then coat the warm donuts. - Poke a hole in each donut, then pipe in the raspberry jam followed by the cheesecake filling. • • • #baking #recipes #recipeideas #bakingideas #donuts

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Cowboy Butter Cheeseburger Sliders These Cowboy Butter Cheeseburger Sliders are cheesy, buttery, and packed with flavor! Perfect for an easy dinner, game day, or feeding a crowd! Ingredients For the Sliders 1 lb ground beef ½ yellow onion, diced 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1 tsp cowboy butter seasoning, or to taste 1 package sliced provolone cheese ⅓ cup French fried onions 1 package slider buns (12 count) 2 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tbsp Dijon mustard For the Cowboy Butter Topping 2 tbsp butter, melted 2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped ½ tsp cowboy butter seasoning Directions 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Add the ground beef and diced onion to a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, until the meat is fully cooked and the onion is tender. Drain any excess grease. 3. Stir in the Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and cowboy butter seasoning. 4. Add 4 slices of provolone cheese and the French fried onions to the beef mixture. Cover the skillet with a lid and allow the cheese to melt. Stir everything together until creamy and combined. 5. Slice the entire package of slider buns in half horizontally. Place the bottom half in a baking dish. 6. In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise and Dijon mustard. Spread the mixture evenly over the bottom buns. 7. Add a layer of provolone cheese over the buns, followed by the cheeseburger mixture. Top with the remaining provolone cheese. 8. Place the top half of the slider buns over the cheese. 9. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, fresh parsley, and ½ teaspoon cowboy butter seasoning. Brush generously over the tops of the sliders. 10. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, or until the sliders are heated through and the cheese is completely melted. 11. Remove the foil and, if desired, bake for another 2–3 minutes to lightly toast the tops. 12. Slice into individual sliders and serve warm. Enjoy! #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #sliders
